description: Java interface defining persistence operations related to entity management, specifically purging entities by ID or collection of IDs, utilizing Akka Streams.

classes.name: EntityPersistenceOperations
classes.description: Interface providing methods for persisting entities, with a focus on purging operations, using reactive streams for error reporting.

methods.name: purgeEntity
methods.description: Purges a single entity identified by its EntityId, returning a reactive stream source that emits any encountered errors.

methods.name: purgeEntities
methods.description: Purges multiple entities given a collection of EntityIds by sequentially merging their error streams into a single source.
